issue_text: REST engine route registration should attach middleware in the expected order and avoid duplicate handlers. The fix belongs in the REST engine.
zrpc client creation should apply target endpoints and dial options consistently when using discovered services. The change belongs in zrpc client setup.
Balancer pickers should report transient failures and ready sub connections without dropping done callbacks. The change belongs in balancer interfaces.
HTTP2 client transport should handle keepalive pings and stream quota updates without leaking streams. The fix belongs in the HTTP2 client transport.
Resolver builders should update target endpoints and service config consistently when resolver state changes. The fix belongs in resolver interfaces and state handling.
Application settings inheritance should preserve enabled and disabled values when mounting a sub application. The fix belongs in application setup logic.
The Express factory should expose Router, request, and response prototypes consistently without mutating shared exports. The fix belongs in the express module entrypoint.
Initialization middleware should attach request and response prototypes to each request without leaking state between apps. The fix belongs in init middleware.
ETag and freshness utilities should normalize weak and strong validators consistently. The change belongs in shared Express utilities, not request or response methods.
View lookup should resolve template extensions and root directories correctly when multiple view paths are configured. The fix belongs in view resolution.
Reading and writing geospatial files chooses the wrong driver options when a path-like object and layer name are supplied. The fix belongs in file IO handling.
GeoDataFrame overlay and geometry column handling produce incorrect output when attributes are preserved across spatial operations. The fix belongs in GeoDataFrame behavior, not plotting or file IO.
GeoSeries coordinate reference system transformations should preserve geometry metadata when applying unary operations. The change belongs in GeoSeries implementation.
HOTP token validation should update the counter correctly when look-ahead succeeds and avoid accepting reused counters. The fix belongs in the HOTP token implementation.
Policy matching applies the wrong scope when user resolver and realm restrictions are combined. The change belongs in policy evaluation logic.
Chained buffers should advance across the first and second buffer correctly when one side is exhausted. The fix belongs in the Buf chain adapter.
Taking a limited view of a buffer should clamp remaining bytes and prevent over-advance. The fix belongs in the take adapter.
Hex formatting should pad and group bytes correctly when rendering debug output for byte slices. The fix belongs in hex formatting.
ArgMatches should report value sources and occurrence counts correctly after parsing grouped short flags. The fix belongs in parsed argument matches.
Command builder configuration should preserve subcommand settings when aliases and visible aliases are combined. The fix belongs in command builder behavior.
Compiler transforms should preserve node source locations when replacing nested expressions. The fix belongs in compiler transform traversal.
Component slots should normalize forwarded slot functions and preserve stable slot flags during updates. The change belongs in component slot handling.
DOM event patching should update cached invokers correctly when listener arrays and once modifiers change. The fix belongs in the runtime DOM events module.
Reactive effects should stop tracking stale dependencies when nested effects are paused and resumed. The fix belongs in effect tracking logic.
Runtime renderer patching should preserve component subtree updates when keyed fragments move between containers. The fix belongs in runtime renderer logic.
